description: Compute a Chilean severance settlement (finiquito): years-of-service indemnity with the 90 UF and 11-year caps, notice-in-lieu, proportional and pending vacation in calendar days, obra o faena scale, unemployment-insurance offset and art. 168 court surcharges. Each item cites its Código del Trabajo article. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /cl/finiquito via x402.

anios_otros_empleadores.description: Years worked for previous employers, for progressive vacation days (at most 10 count).

aviso_previo_dado.description: True if the employer gave 30 days' written notice (then no notice-in-lieu is paid).

causal.description: Termination cause: necesidades_empresa or desahucio (art. 161), obra_faena, vencimiento_plazo, caso_fortuito, mutuo_acuerdo, renuncia, muerte (art. 159), despido_160.

descuento_afc.description: Employer-funded balance of the worker's unemployment account (CLP) to offset against the indemnity (art. 161 or obra o faena only).

despido_injustificado.description: Simulate a court ruling that the dismissal was unjustified (art. 168 surcharges).

dias_no_pagados.description: Days worked in the final month not yet paid (gross, taxable).

fecha_pago.description: Payment date, YYYY-MM-DD; picks the UF for the 90 UF cap. Defaults to fecha_termino.

fecha_termino.description: Last day worked, YYYY-MM-DD (2026–2027, the holiday table's coverage).

region_extrema.description: Works in Magallanes, Aysén or Palena (20 vacation days a year).

remuneracion.description: Last monthly pay in CLP as defined by art. 172 (salary, 3-month average of variable pay, regalías; no overtime or yearly bonuses).

remuneracion_feriado.description: Monthly pay for vacation purposes if different (art. 71).

sin_motivo_plausible.description: With despido_160 and despido_injustificado: the court found no plausible motive (100% surcharge).

vacaciones_pendientes.description: Unused vacation working days from previous years.

name: cl_finiquito
title: Chile: finiquito (severance settlement)
